verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing bullet points about Workstation features (Boxes, containers, Do Not Disturb, etc.) and general community sentiment about Fedora, but nothing about the installer itself, partitioning options, or replacing an existing OS/dual-boot support that a switcher would need. Missing for 10: any documentation or hands-on account of the installation process, disk partitioning/replace-OS workflow, or dual-boot setup.
